comparison: Old and optimized projection/sampling functions in the same cache-owned request loop, same loaded weights; alternating order.

settings.prompt_format: Raw tokenizer.encode without a chat template
prompts: Write a Python function that returns the first n Fibonacci numbers. Include examples.
Explain why the sky is blue in three sentences.
settings.prompt_selection: Batch one uses the first prompt; batch two uses both, left padded.

accounting: Target and MTP prefill are excluded from decode time. Decode throughput counts 255 tokens per row. AR is measured once per batch/temperature; both MTP variants use the same weights, caches, request features, and AR reference. Variant order alternates baseline/optimized then optimized/baseline. This is a short-context controlled projection/sampler comparison, not a new long-context serving benchmark.
